targetStack: Java 17 + Spring Boot 3 + Spring Data JDBC

steps.title: Extract Repository Layer
steps.description: Move all JDBC and raw SQL code into a dedicated CustomerOrderRepository class. Replace string-concatenated queries with PreparedStatement / JdbcTemplate parameterized queries. Define a repository interface for testability.
steps.outcome: Data access is isolated; SQL injection vectors eliminated.

steps.title: Eliminate Hardcoded Credentials
steps.description: Remove DB_URL, DB_USER, DB_PASS, and SMTP_HOST constants. Externalize all configuration to application.properties and inject via Spring @Value or a dedicated config class. Use environment variables in deployment.
steps.outcome: No secrets in source code; configuration is environment-driven.

steps.title: Introduce Connection Pooling
steps.description: Replace DriverManager.getConnection() with a Spring-managed DataSource backed by HikariCP. All connections are now pooled, monitored, and properly returned after use.
steps.outcome: Connection overhead eliminated; app can sustain concurrent load.

steps.title: Add Transaction Management
steps.description: Annotate placeOrder() with @Transactional. All database writes (insert order, decrement stock, audit log) now execute atomically — any failure rolls back the entire operation.
steps.outcome: Data consistency guaranteed across multi-step writes.

steps.title: Decouple Email Notification
steps.description: Extract email logic into a standalone OrderNotificationService. Inject it into CustomerOrderService. Make the send asynchronous using Spring @Async so SMTP latency does not block the request thread.
steps.outcome: Order processing is no longer blocked by email delivery; services are independently testable.

steps.title: Add Unit & Integration Tests
steps.description: Write JUnit 5 tests for CustomerOrderService using Mockito to mock the repository and notification service. Add a @JdbcTest integration test for CustomerOrderRepository using H2 in-memory database.
steps.outcome: 100% coverage on service logic; repository queries verified against schema.
